title: 8 Lies Your Loneliness Tells a Godly Man
caption:
8 lies your loneliness tells a godly man.

"Nobody would notice if I disappeared." "If they knew, they'd leave." "A group chat counts." Loneliness has a script, and it sounds true at 1 AM. Scripture says bear one another's burdens, and God put real men around you on purpose.

Pick one lie from this list and text a brother today.

Save this and send it to the guy who's gone quiet.
